load_error: Could not load Budget. Check your connection and try again.
unavailable_body: Your household role does not include Budget.
ask_adult_title: Ask an adult to set up Budget
ask_adult_body: Once an adult in your household sets it up, you can keep your own envelope here.
setup_intro: Budget gives your household one shared place for envelopes and spending. We'll create an “Everyday” shared envelope to start.
currency_hint: Every amount in your household's budget uses this currency. You can't change it later.
setup_error: Could not set up Budget. This household may already use a different currency.
envelopes_intro: An envelope is a named bucket for spending, such as Everyday or Holidays. It groups purpose or ownership; it is not a bank account.
new_description: Choose a name and who can see it.
rename_description: Only the name changes. Who can see an envelope can't be edited.
name: Name
privacy_shared: Shared envelopes are visible to the household's owners and adults. Children can't see them.
privacy_personal: A personal envelope and its spending are private to its owner. Other adults, including owners, can't see it. Adults who manage a member without a login can see that member's envelope.
no_envelopes_body: Create an envelope to start organising spending.
save_error: Could not save this change. Check your permissions and try again.
conflict_error: Someone else changed this envelope. The list has been refreshed — review it and try again.
expenses_intro: Everything recorded in the envelopes you can see.
add_description: Record a purchase. You are recorded automatically; choose who paid.
correct_description: Changes keep a full history. Say why you are correcting it.
amount_invalid: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals.
date_future: This date is in the future.
paid_by_owner: Paid by {{name}}, the owner of this envelope.
household_funds_note: Paid from household funds: nobody is credited and nothing is split.
split_equal_note: Shares are equal and calculated when you save.
reason_hint: A short note kept in the history.
duplicates_failed: Could not check for similar expenses.
duplicates_skipped: You chose to save without checking.
expense_save_error: Could not save. Your input is kept — try again.
expense_rejected: These details can't be saved. Check the payer, people and envelope.
expense_conflict: Someone else changed this expense. Reload to see the latest version.
void_description: A voided expense stops counting and can't be edited. Its history stays.
no_expenses_body: Add the first purchase to start tracking spending.
no_expenses_filtered_body: Try changing or clearing the filters.
expense_not_found: This expense doesn't exist or you can't see it.
